text:
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ
ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥
meaning: "There is one supreme being, the eternal reality, the creator, without fear and without enmity, timeless in form, beyond birth, self-existent, known by the grace of the Guru" (after Pashaura Singh, 2000). The opening of the Guru Granth Sahib.
purpose: To remember the One, and to live without fear and without enmity.
when: Morning and evening, or whenever one begins something.
note: Composed by Guru Nanak; the first words of the Sikh scripture, the Guru Granth Sahib.
source: Guru Granth Sahib, opening (Mool Mantar); text as printed in the Wikipedia article on the Mul Mantar; translation after Pashaura Singh, 2000
name: Mool Mantar
iast:
Ik Oankar, Sat Naam, Karta Purakh, Nirbhau, Nirvair,
Akaal Moorat, Ajooni, Saibhang, Gur Prasaad.
pronunciation: ik oan-kaar sat naam kar-taa pu-rakh nir-bhau nir-vair; a-kaal moo-rat a-joo-nee sai-bhang gur pra-saad
